props.subTitle: Skin Recovery
props.title: Why Does Sunburned Skin Need Gentle Treatment?
props.text: After prolonged sun exposure, the skin can become warm, dehydrated, tight, and more sensitive than usual. A Sunburn Treatment uses cooling ingredients such as aloe vera together with gentle application techniques to calm overheated skin without adding unnecessary pressure. The goal is to restore comfort, replenish moisture, and support the skin's natural recovery process after time in Bali's tropical sun.
props.feature1Text: Helps calm overheated skin with soothing after-sun ingredients.
props.feature2Text: Light movements designed for skin that feels sensitive or tender.

props.subTitle: Treatment Details
props.title: A Dedicated Session for Sun-Exposed Skin
props.text: Our Sunburn Treatment is provided as a focused one-hour session, giving the skin time to cool, rehydrate, and recover comfortably after beach days, outdoor activities, or extended sun exposure.

props.subTitle: The Benefits
props.title: How Can a Sunburn Treatment Help?
props.text: Sunburn Treatment is designed to improve comfort rather than provide deep massage. Cooling botanical ingredients and gentle techniques work together to calm skin that has become stressed by ultraviolet exposure while supporting healthy moisture levels during recovery.
featuresRight: Suitable after beach holidays or outdoor activities
Promotes a calmer skin sensation during recovery

props.subTitle: Areas of Care
props.title: Which Parts of the Body Are Commonly Treated?
props.text: Every sunburn is different. Our therapists focus on the areas most affected by sun exposure while adapting the treatment according to your skin's condition and comfort throughout the session.
featuresRight: Any sun-exposed skin requiring gentle care

props.subTitle: The Experience
props.title: What to Expect from a Sunburn Treatment
props.text: Our therapist first assesses the condition of your skin before applying cooling aloe vera and soothing botanical products to the affected areas. Gentle, slow movements help spread the products evenly without creating unnecessary friction, while cool compresses may be used to enhance comfort. Every step is performed with sensitive skin in mind, allowing your body to relax while your skin begins its recovery.

items.question: Can I get a massage if I have sunburn?
items.answer: Yes, provided the skin is not blistered or severely damaged. Our Sunburn Treatment avoids deep pressure and uses gentle techniques specifically intended for sensitive skin.

items.question: Why is aloe vera commonly used after sun exposure?
items.answer: Aloe vera is widely used in after-sun care because of its cooling properties and its ability to help maintain skin hydration while soothing temporary discomfort.

items.question: Is this treatment suitable immediately after the beach?
items.answer: Yes. Many guests book this treatment after spending long hours outdoors to help cool and rehydrate their skin.

items.question: Does the treatment focus on the whole body?
items.answer: It can. Our therapist may treat the entire body or concentrate only on the sun-exposed areas that require the most attention.

items.question: Can I return to the sun after my appointment?
items.answer: It's recommended to give your skin time to recover before further sun exposure and to apply appropriate sun protection when going outdoors.

props.title: Give Your Skin the Recovery Time It Deserves
props.text: Hours in Bali's sun can leave skin warm and sensitive. Our Sunburn Treatment cools and rehydrates with aloe vera and botanical ingredients. At our spa, or at your villa or hotel.
props.closingText: Reserve your Sunburn Treatment and let your skin recover comfortably.
